hook.text: Wordless opening: a shallow-focus drift over glowing branch lines labelled with issue IDs that converge into one release line

summary.tone: Minimal, cinematic, confident teaser: monochrome near-black world, monospace type, no voice-over, product metaphor over feature explanation.

signature_moments.description: Many issue-ID branches flow and merge into a single line that terminates at a 'LAUNCH v1.1' node on a tilted release panel.
signature_moments.why_premium: Turns the abstract idea 'many issues ship as one release' into a single elegant visual metaphor built from the product's own data vocabulary.

signature_moments.description: Three tilted release panels (Mobile App, SDK, Production) fan in from darkness with shallow depth of field.
signature_moments.why_premium: Real-camera cues (perspective, focus falloff, soft shadows) make recreated UI feel like a physical object and show multiple release types in one frame.

signature_moments.description: Monospace typewriter reveal 'RELEASES' then 'AVAILABLE NOW' with a block cursor, resolving to the Linear logo.
signature_moments.why_premium: Restrained, on-brand developer-tool typography; the cursor ties the launch message to an engineering audience without extra copy.

hook.evidence: Opens straight into a striking defocused branch-line visual with readable issue IDs; intriguing but does not state the product until the title card.

clarity.evidence: Only 'PLAN AND TRACK RELEASES' explains the feature; the graph metaphor is clear to Linear users but the video shows no concrete workflow or interaction.

ui_showcase.evidence: Release panels with scheduled/continuous status pills are shown, but as stylized recreated UI with no cursor, interaction or real screens.

motion_polish.evidence: From stills: consistent depth-of-field, perspective camera drifts, fades and a typewriter reveal; easing and timing cannot be judged from 2 fps sheets.

sound_design.evidence: Judged from anchors plus visuals: a steady ~110 BPM music bed, integrated loudness -24.7 LUFS (quiet), and no detected SFX; no audible accents on the typewriter or logo per anchors.

vo_script_quality.evidence: No voice-over: anchors contain no transcript words.

brand_consistency.evidence: Strict monochrome near-black world, monospace labels, Linear-style issue IDs and a clean logo end card throughout.

works_muted.evidence: No voice-over; all messaging is on-screen text, so the story is identical with sound off.

overall.evidence: Highly polished, on-brand launch teaser with a strong visual metaphor; limited explanatory depth keeps it short of best-in-class as an explainer.

localization_friendliness.notes: Only a few short headline cards ('PLAN AND TRACK RELEASES', 'RELEASES', 'AVAILABLE NOW') need translation; issue IDs and panel labels can stay in English. No voice-over to re-record.

annotation.composition_other: mixed within one detected shot: full-bleed perspective graph sections, a stacked fan of three tilted panels, and centered type/logo cards
annotation.focal_element: a monochrome branching-line graph where many issue-ID nodes converge into a single release line, later shown on tilted release panels
annotation.transition_other: none: first shot of the video (anchors give transition_in null)
annotation.typography: Monospaced, regular weight, all caps with wide tracking for headlines ('PLAN AND TRACK RELEASES', 'RELEASES', 'AVAILABLE NOW') and for small node labels and panel headers; status pills in small caps with a dot indicator; end card is the sentence-case wordmark 'Linear' in a geometric sans with its logo mark (font guesses low confidence). Node-ID list is partial: many tiny/defocused labels were not legible.
annotation.what_happens: The scene detector found one shot, but the contact sheets show several internal cuts/sections: (1) a close, shallow-depth-of-field drift over glowing curved lines tagged with issue IDs converging to the right; (2) a pulled-back tilted 'MOBILE APP / SCHEDULED RELEASE' panel where all branches merge into a single line ending at a 'LAUNCH v1.1' node; (3) a centered mono title card 'PLAN AND TRACK RELEASES' that fades out; (4) three tilted panels (MOBILE APP, SDK, PRODUCTION / CONTINUOUS RELEASE) fanning in from darkness; (5) another defocused close drift along the PRODUCTION graph; (6) a black card where 'RELEASES' then 'AVAILABLE NOW' type on with a block cursor; (7) the Linear logo lockup end card. No voice-over; music only.
annotation.build_rebuild: Render SVG bezier paths from scattered issue-ID nodes that converge to one release line on a dark 3D-tilted panel (CSS perspective + rotateX/rotateY), drift a camera with depth-of-field blur over it, then cut to a centered monospace typewriter headline with a block cursor and end on a centered logo lockup.

pattern.description: Monospace uppercase line 'AVAILABLE NOW' is typed one character per step behind a solid white block cursor on a near-black starfield; the line stays horizontally centred, so each keystroke nudges the already-typed text left while the cursor advances right.
pattern.why_premium: Strictly rhythmic step timing (energy spikes at a fixed ~5-frame interval) with no easing reads as a precise terminal/command-line voice that matches a developer tool; the restrained palette (white mono type, single block cursor, black field) keeps all attention on the CTA phrase.

build_hint.gsap: Split the line into chars (SplitText type:'chars'), set all autoAlpha:0, then tl.to(chars, {autoAlpha:1, duration:0, stagger:{each:0.083, ease:'none'}}) ; keep the text container centred (text-align:center) so it re-centres per char, and move the block cursor with each char via an onUpdate/stagger callback (gsap.set cursor x to the last visible char's right edge); no tween easing — ease:'steps(1)'. Cursor stays visible (optional blink after settle with repeat:-1, ease:'steps(1)').
build_hint.remotion: const n = Math.floor(frame / 5) (~83 ms per char at 60 fps); render text.slice(0, n) in a centred monospace flex row followed by the block cursor element so layout moves the cursor; no spring or interpolate easing (hard step per char); optional cursor blink via Math.floor(frame/30)%2 after the last char.

events.notes: Event window starts mid-typing ('AVAIL' already present at f1479); earlier chars belong outside this event. Energy shows 8 discrete spikes every 5 frames (B, L, E, space, N, O, W). Facts camera reports move 'none' but scale 1.19 / pan_x -0.07 — likely an artefact of the centred line re-flowing left, not a real camera move; worth a human check. Per-word split b03/b04 chosen over union b01 so cursor b05 is separate.
